text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we're heading back! Time to resume training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia sustained an injury during training,
so I hurriedly brought her to the infirmary, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Overdoing it while injured is bad!
But doing nothing at all can't be good either!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So first, we take action!
Move, and find out what we can do!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's not reckless!
I can do it! I know I can!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: So let us continue training. The Voice of Fate tells me that this is what must be done!
choice_data_list: Even so, I can't allow it
Even so, I can't allow it
...Let's give it a try and see how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: So let us continue training. The Voice of Fate tells me that this is what must be done!
choice_data_list: Even so, I can't allow it
Even so, I can't allow it
...Let's give it a try and see how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Why?! I didn't say
anything wrong!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll win, and show everyone
just how much destiny loves me.
So there's no way I'm stopping here!
choice_data_list: Would resting for just a little while really make you lose?
Would resting for just a little while really make you lose?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No, that's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way in hell I'm weak enough
to lose over something like that!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Because I am beloved by destiny itself!"
choice_data_list: Then, shall we rest for now?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're right, let's rest!
No need to consult the voice of destiny—
I know that's for the best right now.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Rest up properly, build up my spirits, and then unleash it all at once! Yep, let's go with that!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
In that case, let's get back on the track right aw—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm fine! Something like this is nothing—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ouch!
choice_data_list: If you can't move, you shouldn't push yourself.
If you can't move, you shouldn't push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right.
We only figured that out because we tried to act!
So it's all good.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Epiphaneia was forced
to take time off to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hah, whew... Hah, phew...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, muscle training shouldn't be a problem at all!
Hey, do you mind if I do some harder training?
choice_data_list: Let's wait and see how things go a bit longer.
Let's see how things go for a bit longer, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, nothing can be done then.
In that case, I'll just master muscle training as is and make my body thoroughly strong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under my watchful eye, Epiphaneia exercised
within reasonable limits,
properly nursing her injury back to health.
